Disagreements:
1) parse_coupon does not ignore case or surrounding whitespace as spec says.
2) Cart.total adds shipping fee after coupon but incorrectly keeps fixed $60 even when discounted subtotal >=1000, violating spec that free shipping applies.
3) shipping_fee member discount logic fails for discounted subtotal >=1000; it still charges 30 instead of 0 per spec.
